options.name: label
options.description: Accessible name of the File Manager region, such as 'Company documents'.

options.name: provider
options.description: Async storage: list, createFolder, rename, move, delete, upload, and optional getUrl and read; every call receives an AbortSignal.

options.name: root
options.description: The top folder { id, label }; changing it lists the new root.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: No create, rename, move, delete, or upload.

options.name: accept
options.description: Accepted uploads: MIME types (image/*) and extensions (.csv).

options.name: preview
options.description: Preview of opened files: auto (images in an Image Viewer lightbox, text and code in a Code Viewer dialog), false, or a function returning a Node.

options.name: height
options.description: Block size as a CSS length, or null to fill the host.

options.name: view
options.description: List rows with columns, or tiles.

options.name: foldersFirst
options.description: Folders before files, whatever the sort.

options.name: showFolderPane
options.description: Show the folder tree next to the content.

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale of sizes, dates, sorting, and messages.

properties.name: path
properties.description: The path from the root to the current folder.

properties.name: entries
properties.description: Entries of the current folder in display order.

properties.name: loading
properties.description: A folder listing is in progress.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Show a folder (aborts a pending listing).

methods.name: select
methods.description: Select entries of the current folder (no event).

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Upload files to the current folder (checked against accept and maxFileSize).

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options; a new provider or root clears the cache and lists the root.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Abort every provider call and remove rendering, dialogs, and listeners.

events.name: aui-navigate
events.description: Another folder is shown: { folderId, path }.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: The user changed the selection: { selected }.

events.name: aui-open
events.description: A file was opened (Enter or double click): { entry }; preventDefault() suppresses the built-in preview.

events.name: aui-rename
events.description: An entry was renamed: { entry, previousName }.

events.name: aui-move
events.description: Entries were moved: { entries, targetFolderId, source: 'drag' | 'paste' }.

events.name: aui-upload
events.description: One file finished uploading: { entry, file }.

events.name: aui-error
events.description: A provider call failed: { operation, error, entries }.

contentAreas.name: preview
contentAreas.description: A custom preview function returns a Node shown in a dialog titled with the file name.

cssClasses.name: aui-file-manager--fill | --no-pane | --readonly
cssClasses.description: Fills the host; no folder pane; read-only.

cssClasses.name: aui-file-manager__body
cssClasses.description: Splitter of the folder pane and the content.

cssClasses.name: aui-file-manager__columns
cssClasses.description: Sort buttons above the list view.
